## Steering

The change runs in <root>; read its code there. Edit only <root>/openspec/changes/005-requirement.
Approval merges main into osq/005-requirement without running verify; add a task that makes the merged tree pass.
Done tasks stay done: 1. Add a task for new work instead of rewriting a done one.
Run `osq lint 005` and fix every finding. A human runs `osq approve 005`, and the run continues from the first task that is not done.
